items: CBP delays postal formal-entry deadline to Jan. 20, 2027. A final rule moves the compliance date from Oct. 22, 2026 for postal shipments subject to partner agency requirements, Chapter 98 or 99 duties, or duty-free claims. The informal mail entry process under the June 24, 2026 interim rule does not change.

WSJ: Amazon nears Shipping With Amazon launch. Citing anonymous sources, the report says the national delivery service would start in Los Angeles after a trial begun over a year ago, and that Amazon plans to undercut FedEx, UPS and USPS on price. The service has not launched, and the article cites no Amazon statement.

Deposco: Q3 carrier rates fell 3.3% per package. What operators actually paid fell only 0.6% from Q2, the Commerce Signal report said. Deposco said heavier packages, faster services and more residential deliveries absorbed most of the rate relief.
